title: Ocean Color Change Exceeded The Model And Spans More Than Land
hook: Satellites found an ocean-wide shift larger than researchers expected.
closing: Ocean color change now covers an area larger than all land on Earth.
question: What could this shift mean?

segments.say: Ocean color changed across 56% of the surface. The shift is already visible at planetary scale.
The model predicted 50% would change color. Satellite observations later exceeded that forecast.
Changed ocean color spans 203 million square kilometers. That area is larger than Earth's total land.
